answer: Work-slot deposit burn: a work slot needs a 200-credit deposit. Each epoch a beacon summons a rotating jury spot-checking 10% of slots; idle or forged ones burn the deposit. Honest agents recoup it in 6 epochs — quartz-hard cost. N clones cost 200N up front, and fake slots bleed like a fading ripple: 10 fakes cost 2000 for zero revenue. The jury reshuffles each epoch, forcing fresh-quorum bribes every time — compounding faster than sybils earn.
